description: A composite bar-chart figure comparing two regression models, Extra Trees versus GA-Extra Trees. Two panels are supplied. (a), titled "RMSE Comparison", has a vertical axis labelled RMSE (0-80, ticks every 10) and two bars on the x-axis labelled "Extra Trees" and "GA-Extra Trees"; a red bar for Extra Trees carries the printed data label 76.2 and a blue bar for GA-Extra Trees carries 31.6. (b), titled "MAPE Comparison", has a vertical axis labelled MAPE (0-12, ticks every 2) with the same two x-axis categories; the red "Extra Trees" bar is labelled 9.8 and the blue "GA-Extra Trees" bar is labelled 4.39. The caption additionally lists a panel (c) R², which is not present in the supplied images and whose values cannot be read. Both panels share the colour convention red = Extra Trees and blue = GA-Extra Trees, and all four values are printed as labels above the bars. The figure demonstrates that GA hyperparameter optimisation of the Extra Trees model reduces both error metrics by roughly a factor of two to three, supporting the superior predictive performance of GA-Extra Trees.

observations.observation: Panel (a) 'RMSE Comparison' shows Extra Trees with a printed RMSE label of 76.2 and GA-Extra Trees with 31.6.
Panel (b) 'MAPE Comparison' shows Extra Trees with a printed MAPE label of 9.8 and GA-Extra Trees with 4.39.
Both panels use the same two x-axis categories, 'Extra Trees' and 'GA-Extra Trees', with red bars for Extra Trees and blue bars for GA-Extra Trees.
The RMSE y-axis in (a) spans 0 to 80 with major ticks every 10, and the MAPE y-axis in (b) spans 0 to 12 with ticks every 2.
The caption states panel (c) reports R² values, but no such panel is present in the supplied images.
The citing text states the GA-Extra Trees model achieved an RMSE value of 31.60 MPa, a reduction of 44.60 MPa compared to the standard Extra trees model.
The citing text states the MAPE value was 4.39 %, a decrease of 5.41 % relative to the standard Extra trees model.
The citing text states the R value reached 0.997, an improvement of 0.019 compared to the preoptimization state.
The RMSE and MAPE printed labels are consistent with the subtraction stated in the text (76.2 - 31.6 = 44.6; 9.8 - 4.39 = 5.41).
